name: Drive Him Wild
overview: Campus heartthrob and notorious playboy Brady, captain of the hockey team, suddenly finds himself unable to respond to women. The only person who sparks any reaction is Marven, the team's handsome new doctor. The problem? Brady has always seen himself as straight. Marven, open with Brady about being gay and instantly drawn to Brady, uses treatment as an excuse to get closer. As Brady struggles between desire and denial, the two are pulled into a charged, forbidden connection that challenges everything Brady thought he knew about himself.
